notes: Experimental e.s.r. study of H2 on Pt-graphite in the gas-solid system; no uptake amount is measured (signal change in arbitrary units only). Not theoretical_only (experimental work). Not electrochemical: the hydrogen adsorption studied is gas-solid; electrochemistry (potential sweep in 0.5 mol dm-3 H2SO4) is used only to determine Pt coverage (Table 1). is_retracted false; primary research article; no statement that the data were published before. Hence no_conditions_stated (paper has no H2 uptake value).
